description: Review and tutorial papers for the agent's background knowledge base. Only papers whose published version is CC BY (or CC0) are used: fetch_background.py checks the licence with OpenAlex and Crossref before any text is used, and drops the rest. A DOI here is only a hint: the record's title must match. 'library' papers are already in papers/arxiv/ and are CC BY on arXiv. 'licence_printed': the licence the article itself states, used in the credit line. 'links': books and lecture notes that are only linked as further reading (their licence does not allow reusing the text without conditions); 'about' is our own one-line description, used to find them. 'authors_printed': the authors' names as the article prints them, used in the credit line.
